Name: Modify This
Author: aedenthorn
Description:
This mod provides a dialogue menu for performing basic modifications on various things in the player's location. Currently implemented:

[list]
[*][b]Remove[/b] - erase from the current location; works on buildings, objects, stumps, boulders, trees, fruit trees, bushes, and NPCs.
[*][b]Move[/b] - shift one tile in a specified direction; works on buildings, objects, stumps, boulders, trees, fruit trees, and bushes.
[*][b][/b][b]Pick Up[/b] - turn into an inventory item; works on craftable objects (e.g. sprinklers).
[*][b]Grow[/b] - mature to maximum growth; works on crops, tea bushes, trees, fruit trees, children, and animals.
[*][b]Rename[/b] - works on farm animals.
[*][b]Water[/b] - waters the current tile; works on crops.
[*][b]Kill[/b] - set health to -1; works on monsters.
[/list]

To open the dialogue menu, hover over an item and press the hotkey (default: [b]Pause[/b]).

[b]Warning: This is a deceptively powerful tool! Removing or moving things you shouldn't may cause problems for your game.[/b]


[size=4][b]Technical[/b][/size]

Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400/]SMAPI[/url], doesn't use Harmony.

Compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6338]Mod Updater[/url]﻿ for automatic updates.

Code is at [url=https://github.com/aedenthorn/StardewValleyMods]https://github.com/aedenthorn/StardewValleyMods[/url].

﻿﻿If you want to complain or ask for help or help me test my mods, you can visit [url=https://discord.gg/bs6zHuj]my Discord server﻿[/url].

A list of all my mods for Stardew Valley is available at [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/895]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/895[/url].
